सौशल्य

SAUŚALYA . A country in ancient india very famous in the Purāṇas. (mahābhārata, bhīṣma parva, Chapter 9, stanza 40).

सौश्रुति

SAUŚRUTI . Brother of suśarmā the King of trigarta. sauśruti who had fought on the side of the kauravas in the battle of bhārata, was killed by arjuna. (M.B. karṇa Parva, Chapter 27, Verse 3).
